reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering stone nodes and building items, fish, flooring, unusual food and artifacts, strawberries, and straw flooring were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover mining yields, established fish and flooring names, crop timing and repeat harvests, object gender, path instructions, mystery punctuation, and technical preservation; both found no remaining objective issue.

Stone_Node_Description.source: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
Stone_Node_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține piatră, minereuri sau geode.

Stone_NodeWithCoal_Description.source: Break apart to obtain stone with a chance of coal.
Stone_NodeWithCoal_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține piatră și, posibil, cărbune.

StoneFence_Description.source: Lasts longer than a wood fence.
StoneFence_Description.translation: Rezistă mai mult decât un gard de lemn.

Stonefish_Description.source: A bizarre fish that's shaped like a brick.
Stonefish_Description.translation: Un pește bizar în formă de cărămidă.

StoneFloor_Description.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
StoneFloor_Description.translation: Așaz-o pe sol pentru a crea poteci sau pentru a-ți înfrumuseța podelele.

StoneWalkwayFloor_Description.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
StoneWalkwayFloor_Description.translation: Așaz-o pe sol pentru a crea poteci sau pentru a-ți decora podelele.

StrangeDoll_Description.preservationReason: The three question marks are the complete player-facing mystery description and must remain unchanged.

Strawberry_Description.source: A sweet, juicy favorite with an appealing red color.
Strawberry_Description.translation: Un fruct îndrăgit, dulce și zemos, de o atrăgătoare culoare roșie.

StrawberrySeeds_Description.source: Plant these in spring. Takes 8 days to mature, and keeps producing strawberries after that.
StrawberrySeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le primăvara. Ajung la maturitate în 8 zile și continuă să producă apoi căpșune.
